lines: Who was going to make the first moveー
Our gazes were fixed, trying to figure out each other's next move.
Saya NEO had taken advantage of us being focused on each other and quickly dashed away.
Ah! Dammit!! Wait!ーI'll spare y'all for now!
Hestia shouted and disappeared in pursuit of Saya NEO.
Fuma-chan! Let's go after her too!
If we don't hurry, she's going to get captured by those soldiers!
After running through the tunnel and returning back to the surface, we had lost sight of Saya NEO and decided to split up to search the area.
I hope Hebiko and Shikanosuke will be alright.
No need to worry. Hebiko-chan especially has always been a hard worker, unlike a certain someone...
Originally, the Shido Clan that Rinka-senpai belonged to had been one of the "Eight Generals of the Fuma," along with the Nisha Clan and Fuma head family that Gaiza and I respectively belonged to.
However, when Danjo rebelled, they declared neutrality, then went on to become a powerful clan within Gosha, and at this time, Rinka and I were no more than a junior and senior from the same school.
But because of this old connection, we had known each other for a long time, and this was also why I had been able to ask for her cooperation this time.
I-I mean, I'm not useless anymo-...
Suddenly, Rinka-senpai interrupted me in a hushed voice.
We were at a deserted construction site. A huge group, most likely pursuers from the secret service agency "G," were conducting a massive search there to keep Saya from getting away.
"District A, in position!" "Destroy any possible hiding spots!"
There's so many of them... and they even brought those tanks.
They seem to be really desperate. Powered exoskeletons and multi-legged tanks... It's only one girl and they brought enough to fight a war.
This is too dangerous. Should we pull back for now?
They should know more about Saya NEO than we do.
I see, so you mean they most likely have a reason to be searching this place...
Right. And if we stay here and keep watch, we'll notice even if they find her before us.
Let's hide behind those stacks of materials over there and observe.
We quietly hid ourselves in the shadow of some materials stored a short distance away.
"Did you find her!?" "Not yet!" "Call for more reinforcements! We're going to search every inch of this place!"
(They're being really thorough. Are they focusing their search on this area?)
(It's almost as if they're convinced that she's hiding here...)
Suddenly hearing someone call to me, I turned around and found Saya NEO smiling at me innocently.
Here...!? I couldn't feel her presence at all!!
We quickly readied our weapons. The soldiers from "G" hadn't noticed us yet. This was a chance we might not get againー
Thank you for saving me earlier.
The words coming out of Saya's mouth took me by surprise.
(Saving her...? We just prevented her from falling into "G's" hands...)
We were trying to eliminate her. We might even be worse than "G."
(Her misunderstanding might make our job easier... How I wish I could be ruthless enough to think like that...)
I was at a loss for what to do. Saya didn't seem to be on her guard at all and slowly came up to me.
What's that...? You're smelling really good.
That can't be... If anything I must stink like sweat?
Oh, Fuma, you're already a proper adult, so better watch how you smell, okay?
Perhaps because she really thought I smelled good, Saya clung to my torso almost like a child and wouldn't let go.
Anyways, it's dangerous here. Let's go somewhere safe for now...
Suddenly there was a huge crash and the pile of materials that we had been hiding behind collapsed. A cloud of dust painted the surrounding area white.
There she is!! I found Saya NEO!!
Damn it...! I guess for now we'll have to fight them!
